last_debrief: STORY SO FAR: Sun 08-02 — PARKED MID-SESSION, BUT THE DIAGNOSIS RESTARTED AND THAT IS THE FINDING. Story Day opened on the dinner table; three cold fires, zero cold, and the drill test FAILED as feared — but failed in a way that reveals four days of mis-aimed doses. FIRE 1 'neenga ellaarum saapteengala?' → he gave 'ama neenga sappiten': echoed HER pronoun (neenga for naanga) and the one-man tail. Handed him saaptom; he read it back (hinted, does not count). FIRE 2, fresh room, 'enga poneenga inniki?' two-part day-recap → 'market-ku poganom. romba nalla iruka.' THE -ஓM TAIL TRANSFERRED UNPROMPTED — that is new and real. But he hung it on the OBLIGATION body (poga-). FIRE 3, after I taught bodies-vs-tails, 'padam paatheengala?' → 'film-ku paarthuchu': BODY CORRECT AND UNPROMPTED (paarth-!), wrong tail — he grabbed -uchu off irundhuchu, which I had handed him sixty seconds earlier. THE RE-DIAGNOSIS: this was NEVER a person-agreement problem. 1pl-past-om and past-tense have been logged 5x/4x as if the -ஓம் tail were failing; it is not. Two separate machines: (1) PAST-BODY SELECTION — po has three bodies (poren / poganum / ponen) and he has never been shown the body is a CHOICE; he has only ever been given whole past words to memorise by ear. (2) THE -உச்சு CONFUSION — he reads -uchu as 'the past tail' when it is the IT-tail (irundhuchu = it was, mudinjuchu = it finished); people take -en/-om/-eenga/-aanga. Episode 07-31, memo 08-01, drill 08-01 all soaked whole past WORDS and none of them ever taught the operation — the channel escalation was aiming at the wrong target, so 'change the format' was the wrong lesson to draw. The teach that landed today: two decisions every time, pick the body then pick the tail; and the hook was that he already OWNS three past bodies (paarthen, sonneenga, saaptom) without knowing they were the same move. NEW SLIP TAG: it-tail-uchu. CARRIED FORWARD, NOT DONE: fires 2 and 3 both still open, no soak order set, no field mission assigned, campaign block untouched — Andrew pivoted the session to engineering (Anna knock-reply gap + the Mum/Doodah greeting) and said he would finish the lesson later. NEXT OPEN RESUMES HERE: re-fire ponom and paarthom cold in fresh rooms; if the body/tail split holds after one teach, the four-day channel escalation was a mis-diagnosis and the ledger's two old tags should be read as one stem problem. ALSO BANKED: he told me TWICE today, once in session and once by phone knock, that he cannot read Tamil script in text — I broke the phonetic-in-chat rule in the opening beat and the knock lane emits script in text bodies too. Second data point; it is a mechanism gap, not a taste note. CARRIED: kudunga episode M80 SHIPPED (19 days late, lint bounced the first attempt for naming him in the script). Delight still 1 cold of 27. TEN DAYS TO TOUCHDOWN.
